description: This Java source file defines an Android IntentService called BigPictureSocialIntentService, which handles updating and managing notifications with BigPictureStyle for a social app, including responding to user comments and creating notifications with remote input actions.

classes.name: BigPictureSocialIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles updating social app notifications with comments, particularly utilizing BigPictureStyle notifications with inline reply actions for Wear OS.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents, specifically handling actions for adding comments to notifications.

methods.name: handleActionComment
methods.description: Handles the user comment: updates the existing notification with the new comment and publishes it.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Extracts the comment text from the RemoteInput results in the intent.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigPictureStyle
methods.description: Recreates or builds a NotificationCompat.Builder instance with BigPictureStyle, including remote input and actions, to restore or create notifications.
